request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MARKET

layers.text: Paint every red stripe of the tent one flat solid bright red with a slightly darker red shade, with no orange, brown or dark red speckles in the red or along the seams. Repaint the orange and brown crates and barrel in pale straw-yellow birch wood. Keep the tent shape, the cream stripes, the red pennant, the yellow and green goods, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under it.
